hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$c" in *"git commit"*) b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); case "$b" in main|master) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Refusing to commit on %s. Branch first: git checkout -b <name>, then commit."}}' "$b";; esac;; esac; exit 0
